resources.string: Some Bluetooth remotes stop working over Bluetooth after the TV is switched off: the TV keeps them paired but no longer hears them. Tick those remotes here. For 10 minutes after the TV starts, after one of them disconnects or after you open this app, it keeps the TV listening, so it connects the remote as soon as you press a key. If it still does not connect after 10 seconds of presses, the app pairs it again. Remote with no batteries? Put them in and open this app, or pair it again with its key combination.
No Bluetooth low energy devices are paired with this TV. Pair the remote once in Settings, then come back.
Paired, not connected: waiting for a key press
Before it can watch for your remotes
Allow location: Android only shows Bluetooth devices to an app that may use location. The app never reads where the TV is.

Allow location all the time: without it Android hides the remotes from the app while it listens with this screen closed, for example right after the TV starts. If the button does not offer it, run adb shell pm grant io.github.eltorres.reconectarmandos android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.
Turn on location in Settings > Privacy > Location.
Turn on Bluetooth in Settings > Remotes & Accessories.
